s21.logistic-regression.name: Logistic regression
s21.logistic-regression.what: A weighted sum of the predictors, turned into a chance. The plain baseline.
s21.logistic-regression.pre: Numbers: median fill and scaling. Categories: most-frequent fill and one-hot.

s21.random-forest.name: Random Forest
s21.random-forest.what: Hundreds of decision trees, each on a random slice, averaged.
s21.random-forest.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.

s21.xgboost.name: XGBoost
s21.xgboost.what: Trees added one at a time, each correcting the last. The usual accuracy leader.
s21.xgboost.pre: Numbers: median fill. Categories: coded as integers the trees split on.
